tools.name: boldtrail_list_contacts
tools.description: List or search contacts (leads) in BoldTrail kvCORE. Filter by exact email, hashtags, assigned agent id, or registration time (Unix timestamps). Paged: page starts at 1, limit 1-500 (default 100). Endpoint: GET /v2/public/contacts.

tools.name: boldtrail_create_contact
tools.description: Create a new contact (lead) in BoldTrail kvCORE. Search first with boldtrail_list_contacts: the API accepts duplicates. Set assigned_agent_id to assign the lead to an agent, and owned_by_assigned to true to keep it private to that agent. Endpoint: POST /v2/public/contact.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: boldtrail_list_contacts, boldtrail_create_contact · Private data: boldtrail_list_contacts, boldtrail_create_contact · Public sink: boldtrail_list_contacts, boldtrail_create_contact.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: boldtrail_list_contacts, boldtrail_create_contact · Private data: boldtrail_list_contacts, boldtrail_create_contact · Public sink: boldtrail_list_contacts, boldtrail_create_contact

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
